Hi Alice / team,

Thanks again for the sync yesterday. Per our call I pulled together a focused plan to validate performance during onboarding so we can sign the acceptance criteria and flip the prod switch. Attached: a first-draft load plan and our acceptance checklist. Key asks below — please confirm availability for the test window (proposed June 6-7) and the engineering contacts who will run the client-side harness.

Acceptance targets (preliminary) — propose we lock these before running tests:
- Steady-state throughput: 600 req/s sustained for 30 minutes (95% payload mix)
- Tail latency: p99 < 300ms, p95 < 120ms (end-to-end, 512-token average)
- Cold-start path (KV-cache empty): p95 < 250ms during 5-minute ramp
- Error rate: < 0.5% of requests failed (5xx/4xx)

Planned tests in the attached load plan:
- Ramp and soak (verify steady-state)
- Spike (3x for 2 minutes)
- Chaos: node restart during soak (optional, coordinate with Redwood infra)
- Latency breakdown capture (client -> front proxy -> model -> network)

Deliverables from each side:
- EchoHealth: client harness config, target script, and a dedicated test VPC subnet access (or IP allowlist); point person for test day
- Redwood: test harness runner, PV metrics (token-level cost breakdown), and acceptance report with raw traces and aggregated dashboards

Next steps:
1) Alice: confirm test window or propose alternate dates by EOD Friday
2) Ben: I'll need the final ramp/shards config after we get EchoHealth harness details
3) Monica: we'll prepare the acceptance report template and share drive folder
